verdict.rationale: Docusign documents multiple AI-generated insight features directly in-product: AI-Assisted Summary and Q&A for signers, AI-Assisted Review that flags risky language, suggests redlines, and drafts new clauses against playbooks, and CLM's AI clause-compliance flagging and drafting. These are first-party vendor claims with no independent hands-on corroboration of the AI quality itself. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation of AI insight accuracy, and no community evidence confirming these AI features work as described in practice.
